en: Black‑and‑white view over a small town or village with traditional European houses surrounded by many trees. In the foreground are orderly rows of stacked artillery shells or similar cylindrical objects laid out in a yard, suggesting a wartime or military‑supply scene. A two‑storey plastered building with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows faces the street; its ground floor appears to contain several shops with signs above the windows and a horse‑drawn cart or early vehicle in front. Behind it are larger barns and half‑timbered houses on a gentle slope, typical of central European rural architecture.
